title: Disclosure Begets Disclosure: A Self-Reinforcing Privacy Loop in LLM Agents with Persistent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.28315v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use persistent memory to personalize responses, and personal attributes in this memory pose a privacy risk if exposed. We ask how consulting memory during dialogue changes what users go on to say, and thus what the memory comes to reveal. In multi-session simulations, a simulated user with 24 personal attributes talks with a support agent that does or does not consult memory, and in both settings attributes are inferred from the full accumulated record. Across four support models, memory raises response quality but also empirical leakage, the share of attribute values correctly inferred from the record, by a margin that widens over sessions. The cause is a loop in ordinary, non-adversarial assistance. Memory-conditioned responses carry earlier values forward, often as presuppositions, and users affirm them or leave them uncorrected, so that cues and the agent's own guesses become recorded

translated_title: 披露引发披露：具有持久记忆的LLM智能体中的自我强化隐私循环
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体越来越多地使用持久记忆来个性化响应，而记忆中存储的个人属性一旦暴露便构成隐私风险。我们探究在对话中查阅记忆如何改变用户后续的发言内容，进而改变记忆最终会揭示的信息。在多会话模拟中，一个拥有24个个人属性的模拟用户与一个查阅或不查阅记忆的客服智能体对话，并在两种设置下均从完整累积的对话记录中推断这些属性。在四个客服模型上，使用记忆提升了响应质量，但同时也增加了经验性泄露——即从记录中能被正确推断出的属性值比例——且这一差距随会话次数增加而不断扩大。其根源在于普通的、非对抗性辅助过程中存在的一个循环：基于记忆的响应会将早期的属性值延续下去（常以预设的形式出现），而用户会确认这些值或不予纠正，从而使线索和智能体自身的猜测都被记录下来。
tldr: 该研究揭示了持久记忆型LLM智能体中存在自我强化的隐私泄露循环：基于记忆的响应会将早期属性值作为预设延续，用户确认或不加纠正，导致属性泄露随会话次数持续扩大。
en_tdlr: This study reveals a self-reinforcing privacy loop in LLM agents with persistent memory: memory-conditioned responses carry earlier attribute values forward as presuppositions, which users affirm or leave uncorrected, causing empirical attribute leakage to widen over sessions.
